# FastPress Start

> A free, zero-build launch page template for people who ship.

FastPress Start is an Apache-2.0 HTML/CSS/JavaScript template with SEO, Open Graph, a working form, privacy and terms starting pages, accessibility, agent-readable files and a public LaunchGrade audit.

## Live demo

- https://fastpresspages.github.io/fastpress-start/
- Audit report: https://fastpresspages.github.io/fastpress-start/samples/fastpress-start/report.html

## What it includes

- One `index.html`, one `styles.css`, one `app.js`, one `config.js`.
- Email form with validation, honeypot, timeout and honest error handling. FormSubmit by default.
- Title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card, JSON-LD, sitemap and robots.
- `llms.txt`, `AGENTS.md`, semantic HTML, no-JS copy.
- Skip link, landmarks, labelled fields, visible focus, reduced-motion support.
- No analytics, cookies, pixels or localStorage.

## Use it

1. Fork or use the template: https://github.com/fastpresspages/fastpress-start/generate
2. Edit `index.html` for your copy.
3. Edit `config.js` for your form endpoint, email and URLs.
4. Replace `privacy.html` and `terms.html` with your own practices.
5. Replace the proof section with real proof, or delete it.
6. Serve locally: `node scripts/serve.js`
7. Audit: `npx -p github:fastpresspages/launchgrade launchgrade http://127.0.0.1:4173`
8. Deploy with GitHub Pages (Settings → Pages → Source: GitHub Actions).

## Rules

- Do not invent proof, metrics, testimonials or partnerships.
- Do not add tracking to a page that promises no tracking.
- Do not put a secret key in client-side code.
- If you change the URL, update the canonical, OG/Twitter URLs, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt` and `llms.txt`.
